testsuite.name: B - Mhamad - Editing and deletion
testsuite.details:
Member 2 / B: Mhamad (GitHub MhammedAzad). Group TaskFlow; leader Aland Karwan. SECJ3343 Project 1 Test Case Design, due 27 October 2026. Basis: README.md TF-REQ-009 through TF-REQ-015 and editing persistence in TF-REQ-018, TaskFlow main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements are identified in the requirements.

Scope: prefilled edits, valid and rejected edits, identity/timestamps, every edit dismissal path, priority edit persistence, exact deletion confirmation, every deletion dismissal path, intended-target isolation and repeated operations. Creation, text boundary sweeps, enum/date partitions, counts/status transitions, queries, general storage recovery and navigation belong to other members. Their actions are setup only. All cases are manual and Not Run.

Each case independently resets ONLY a disposable Chrome profile at http://localhost:5173 using the complete fixture instructions in its preconditions. Never use personal task storage. Read ISO timestamps in stored JSON, not the day-resolution Created label. Observe specified success messages within three seconds. Numbered steps are generated from the ordered action/expected-result tuples.
